gloss: to remake; to redo; to make over

definitions.gloss: to remake; to redo; to make over again
definitions.explanation: To make something again from scratch or to substantially rework it, typically because the original was unsatisfactory or needs updating.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{作|つく}り{直|なお}す。
⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{間違|まちが}い→間違い：03733_machigai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{作|つく}り{直|なお}した。
examples.english: There was a mistake in the document, so I redid it.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{棚|たな}→棚：01650_tana⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古|ふる}く→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{木材|もくざい}→木材：13017_mokuzai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{作|つく}り{直|なお}そう。
examples.english: This shelf has gotten old, so let's rebuild it with new lumber.

notes:
A compound verb combining ⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ (to make) and {直|なお}す (to fix/redo). The {直|なお}す auxiliary indicates doing the action over again, typically to improve or correct the result.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{最初|さいしょ}→最初：00882_saisho⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{作|つく}り{直|なお}す: to remake from scratch
- ⟦{一|いち}→一：00705_ichi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{作|つく}り{直|なお}す: to redo from the beginning
- ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{作|つく}り{直|なお}す: to redo a plan
- ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{作|つく}り{直|なお}す: to remake a dish

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{書|か}き{直|なお}す→書き直す：04597_kakinaosu⟧: to rewrite — specifically for writing
- ⟦やり{直|なお}す→やり直す：03172_yarinaosu⟧: to redo — more general, not limited to making/creating
- ⟦{立|た}て{直|なお}す→立て直す：03113_tatenaosu⟧: to rebuild, to reorganize — often used for plans, health, or organizations
